name: Zomp
lede: Zomp is a vivid blue-green whose name's origin our sources do not document, close in hue to tsavorite garnet.

sections.title: Origin undocumented
sections.body:
Our data files Zomp from Wikipedia's color lists alone, with no date, person or place behind the name [1]. In LCH terms it sits near the Persian-green end of our Greens family [1].

The nearest look-alikes are [[persian-green]], 3.1 units away, almost the same, and [[jungle-green]], 3.4 units away, more vivid; [[greeny-blue]] follows at 3.7, lighter [2]. Among gems, the closest match is tsavorite, a chromium-green variety of [[gem:garnet|garnet]], only 3.1 units off [2]. Among films, the nearest named match in our data is the deep green of Vertigo (1958), though at 9.8 units it reads only as a distant cousin, not a true match [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The color is rare in our archive, found in just 3 of 23,781 paintings as photographed, rarer than 88 percent of the names we track [3]. The sample is too small for century, painter or role data [3].
